Job Summary

The Director of Development for Athletics will serve as a professional in the Athletic Department to cultivate and solicit former student athletes and coaches, alumni, parents, friends, community members, foundations and corporations for contributions. The incumbent will participate in a comprehensive college-based development program by identifying, qualifying, cultivating, and soliciting major gifts; understand and comply with the policies, procedures and best practices established by University Development; foster successful major gift fundraising by preparing academic leaders to participate routinely and effectively in development activities and prospect appointments; and participate in college based programs that identify and encourage relationships with donors, prospects and alumni.

Department Summary

Cal Poly Athletics is committed to providing broad-based, high-quality and competitive NCAA Division I athletic programs that afford student-athletes opportunities to take advantage of our unique Learn by Doing philosophy. Cal Poly Athletics embodies the transformative power of physical activity, fostering skill development, teamwork, sportsmanship, and a commitment to excellence. We take pride in offering students meaningful learning experiences that complement their academic pursuits. Mustang Athletics enriches collegiate life, uniting a diverse community of students, faculty, staff, and alumni through shared pride and spirit.

The role of the University Development and Alumni Engagement (UDAE) Division is to foster strong relationships with external partners while enhancing support for Cal Poly. University Development and Alumni Engagement does this by implementing an overall advancement program that includes alumni and parent engagement, community outreach, coordinated fundraising efforts, donor relations, gift processing, trust and endowment management, training and systems support for the donor database, and Cal Poly Foundation support and administration.

Key Qualifications

Develop and manage a personal portfolio of an assigned number of prospective annual and major gift prospects/donors, while maintaining confidentiality. Manage prospect, identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship. Conduct an assigned number of significant or substantive donor meetings annually. Submit an assigned number of major gift proposals annually.
Develop and implement strategies and campaigns for solicitation of major ($25,000 +) and principal ($1M +) gifts including determining ongoing relationships with prospects/donors; recommending specific purpose and level of gift; identifying those to be involved in cultivation and subsequent solicitation; and carry out solicitations.
In conjunction with input from the assigned manager and the assigned Assistant/Associate Vice President in University Development and Alumni Engagement, execute assigned portion of the annual development plan. Responsible for personal and college metrics and goals that result from the annual development plan.
Develop written proposals for presentation to major and principal level donors, corporate sponsors, and foundations; develop gift agreements and confer with appropriate administrative personnel to secure closure of the gift; oversee accounting, gift recording and acknowledgement procedures and reporting; oversee compliance for in-kind giving.
Work collaboratively with central University Development & Alumni Engagement partners including, but not limited to, Annual Giving, Planned Giving, Corporation Relations, Foundation Relations, Gift Administration, and Parent Philanthropy on campaigns for solicitations.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of four years of progressively responsible professional experience in development, major gifts fundraising, donor relations, marketing, planned giving or other related professional experience with two years being direct fundraising experience. Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis.

Possession of a valid driver’s license or the ability to obtain one by date of hire.

CEO Narrative and Positioning

Develop the CEO’s proprietary narrative platform (core themes, POVs, proof points) aligned to Alteryx strategy, differentiation, and market opportunities.
Translate company strategy into CEO-ready messaging, including crisp “so what” articulation for business, tech, and data/AI audiences.

Broadcast (including TV)

Develop CEO voice, cadence, and guardrails

Experience building modern executive social strategy that drives credibility, trust, and talent impact.

High-Touch Marketplace Co-Selling & Deal Architecture

Collect and prioritize input on missing features (especially regarding services monetization), building data-driven business cases that separate true roadmap priorities from one-off requests.
AI-First Infrastructure: Own the pipeline tracking, KPIs, reporting, and roadmap reviews for this motion. Ensure all internal workflows and program management strategies are AI-first by default, leveraging automation to maximize ecosystem scale.
Supporting the "Products + Services" GTM Motion (0-to-1 Blueprint)

Utilize data and employee feedback to continuously improve offerings and address evolving workforce needs.

Partner with finance to provide U.S. benefit budget, forecasting, cost modeling and financial reporting.
Ensure adherence to all applicable laws and regulations (e.g., ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, FMLA).

Mergers, Acquisitions And Divestitures

Develop and implement cost-effective benefit transition strategies for acquired companies.

Strong analytical and financial acumen with the ability to interpret data and drive insights.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build trust across all levels.
Strategic mindset with operational excellence and attention to detail.

15+ years of benefits experience with positions of increasing responsibility.
Experience and success in managing benefits for a large, complex organization.
Deep expertise in U.S. benefit plans, regulations, reporting requirements and market trends.
Merger & Acquisition due diligence and benefit integration experience.
Experience managing people, teams and projects.
S. public company experience.

Experience working with collective bargaining units (unions and/or works councils).
Proficiency in HRIS systems and benefits platforms.

jobs.description:
Hire Heroes USA empowers service members, veterans and their spouses to succeed in the civilian workforce.

About The Organization

Hire Heroes USA is the nation's leading veteran employment nonprofit, providing personalized career coaching, professionally written resumes, mentoring, training workshops, virtual career fairs, a job board, and more – at no cost to the service members we support. Since our founding in 2005, Hire Heroes USA has maintained a singular focus on veteran and military spouse employment, successfully enabling over 120,000 veterans and military spouses to be hired into civilian careers. We also work with companies to attract, connect with, and hire qualified veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses through customized recruiting support, strategic workforce partnerships, and access to a nationwide pipeline of highly skilled talent.

Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, Hire Heroes USA operates nationally, with 5 offices across the U.S. and a talented team of 155+. Our team is committed to providing one-on-one personalized support and dedicated guidance to those we serve, and is driven by our core values of Integrity, Effectiveness, Commitment, Excellence, and Inclusion in everything we do.

Hire Heroes USA has built a national reputation of excellence. Prioritizing transparency, Hire Heroes USA earned a 4-star rating and score of 100% from Charity Navigator, as well as Candid's Platinum Seal of Transparency. Funded exclusively through public donations and private grants, we provide our services at no cost to clients – after all they've given our nation, we want to provide the support they need to ensure their next steps are successful ones, no matter where they start or where they're headed.

For more information about our mission and our work, please visit our website.

About The Role

What You'll Do

Hire Heroes USA is seeking a strategic, charismatic, mission-driven leader to serve as our next Chief Executive Officer. Reporting to the Board of Directors and overseeing a team of 155+ and budget of $20M+, the CEO will build on the organization's strong foundation and successful track record to further elevate our brand, increase funding, forge new partnerships, and shape our future strategy. The CEO will be responsible for designing and guiding a vision for organizational growth, enabling Hire Heroes USA to scale our services and broaden our reach while simultaneously maintaining our deeply personalized approach. Additionally, the CEO will lead efforts to diversify funding; build new partnerships with a wide variety of stakeholders; continually improve internal systems and processes; manage, motivate, and inspire a national team; and serve with integrity as the public face of the organization. This is an ideal opportunity for a visionary and dynamic leader to build upon Hire Heroes USA's strong foundation and reputation, and take the organization to the next level; the ideal candidate is a seasoned leader with a demonstrated passion for serving military veterans, proven experience crafting organizational strategy, and strong relationship building and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Strategy & Management

Set and drive organizational strategy, enabling Hire Heroes USA to scale our programmatic reach and impact while simultaneously preserving our personalized approach.
Collaborate with the Board, staff, and key stakeholders to set clear, data-driven goals to grow the organization, enhance our impact, and achieve our mission.
Serve as a financial steward for the organization, working in collaboration with the VP, Finance, and Board to ensure that strong financial goals are set and achieved.
Develop, maintain, and engage a strong Board of Directors, including supporting strong Board governance; partnering closely with Board committees; and leading quarterly Board meetings.
Oversee the successful execution of the organization's day-to-day operations through effective management and empowerment of the senior leadership team, and implementation of best in class systems and processes.

External Leadership & Fundraising

Serve as the face of Hire Heroes USA, speaking publicly about the organization's work to the media, with donors, and at various public/private events; demonstrate exceptional communication skills and the ability to captivate audiences and build authentic connections with a diverse array of stakeholders.
Maintain existing funder relationships and implement expanded funding strategies that generate new revenue from various sources, including individual gifts, corporate partnerships, and other sources to diversify funding and ensure organizational sustainability and growth.
Foster strategic partnerships and collaborations with external stakeholders, corporate partners, and other organizations to amplify Hire Heroes USA's reach and impact.
Serve as a thought leader in the nonprofit / veteran / workforce space; elevate your own and Hire Heroes USA's presence across relevant platforms, audiences, and communities.
Enhance brand awareness of Hire Heroes USA and secure increased philanthropic investment, enabling the organization to grow to $50M+ over the next few years.

Mission & Culture Leadership

Embody and actively promote Hire Heroes USA's core values of Integrity, Effectiveness, Commitment, Excellence, and Inclusion, leading by example and fostering a mission-centric and values-driven team environment.
Serve as a leader of leaders, managing and mentoring a high-performing, diverse team with a commitment to strong staff engagement; authentically motivate and inspire staff to perform at their best and go above and beyond for the service members, veterans, and military spouses they support.
Drive organization-wide results with inspirational leadership, effective and supportive management, and well-defined objectives with accountability mechanisms and key performance indicators to track progress.
Foster collaboration across the organization; encourage a culture that promotes learning, development, growth, and accountability.
Invest in the recruitment and retention of top talent, aligned with Hire Heroes USA's core values; empower and develop team members to perform at their best and reach their full potential.

Who You'll Work With

The CEO will report to Hire Heroes USA's Board of Directors and work especially closely with the Chairman of the Board. Additionally, the CEO will directly manage a senior leadership team of 4 and be responsible for an overall team of 155+. Learn more about the Board and Leadership Team.

Required Skills And Experience

Deep alignment to Hire Heroes USA's organizational culture and core values, including a strong appreciation and understanding of the military veteran community.
A minimum of 5+ years of executive leadership experience (i.e.: CEO or divisional leadership), with demonstrated ability to manage the strategic, operational, and human capital needs of a national organization.
Exceptional communication skills, with an ability to connect with a wide range of audiences in a variety of settings (e.g. media engagements, Board meetings, donor pitches, government meetings, etc.).
Proven experience building and managing large, complex, high-performing teams to achieve ambitious goals; a highly collaborative and values-aligned leadership approach.
Demonstrated success developing and translating vision into strategy, and a track record of designing and implementing plans for achieving ambitious growth.
Strong outcomes orientation with an ability to make data-driven decisions and maintain a constant eye on Hire Heroes USA's highest priorities in a dynamic environment.
Demonstrated success generating revenue, including a proven track record of raising capital across a wide variety of revenue streams; experience with corporate partnerships and/or major gifts is preferred.
Proven track record of finding, retaining, and cultivating strong collaborative partnerships over time.
Experience leading geographically dispersed teams in a hybrid work environment.
Ability to travel and have a presence at team, Board, and donor/partner meetings as needed.

Additional Details

Hire Heroes USA is headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia and currently operates in a remote/hybrid fashion. As the organization evolves, the CEO will lead the charge in redefining our workplace strategy, transitioning the team from current hybrid practices to a unified, in-person operational model. To effectively lead this transition by example, the CEO will ideally be based in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Candidates relocating to the Atlanta area will be eligible for relocation support. The CEO will be expected to travel as needed for team meetings, donor cultivation, and other events, with some seasonal expectations exceeding 60%.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $250K - $300K annually, depending on prior experience and qualifications; additionally, there is opportunity for performance-based compensation as the organization grows and key performance indicators are met.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Hire Heroes USA, we embrace that same spirit by ensuring that every veteran and military spouse has access to the resources and opportunities needed to thrive in the civilian workforce. We uphold these same values within our own team, bringing together employees with varied skills and experiences to best serve our mission.

Organizational Strategy & Management

Collaborate with the Board, staff, and key stakeholders to set clear, data-driven goals to grow the organization, enhance our impact, and achieve our mission.

Develop, maintain, and engage a strong Board of Directors, including supporting strong Board governance; partnering closely with Board committees; and leading quarterly Board meetings.
Oversee the successful execution of the organization's day-to-day operations through effective management and empowerment of the senior leadership team, and implementation of best in class systems and processes.

External Leadership & Fundraising

Foster strategic partnerships and collaborations with external stakeholders, corporate partners, and other organizations to amplify Hire Heroes USA's reach and impact.
Serve as a thought leader in the nonprofit / veteran / workforce space; elevate your own and Hire Heroes USA's presence across relevant platforms, audiences, and communities.
Enhance brand awareness of Hire Heroes USA and secure increased philanthropic investment, enabling the organization to grow to $50M+ over the next few years.

Drive organization-wide results with inspirational leadership, effective and supportive management, and well-defined objectives with accountability mechanisms and key performance indicators to track progress.
Foster collaboration across the organization; encourage a culture that promotes learning, development, growth, and accountability.
Invest in the recruitment and retention of top talent, aligned with Hire Heroes USA's core values; empower and develop team members to perform at their best and reach their full potential.

Who You'll Work With

The CEO will report to Hire Heroes USA's Board of Directors and work especially closely with the Chairman of the Board. Additionally, the CEO will directly manage a senior leadership team of 4 and be responsible for an overall team of 155+. Learn more about the Board and Leadership Team.

Required Skills And Experience

Deep alignment to Hire Heroes USA's organizational culture and core values, including a strong appreciation and understanding of the military veteran community.
A minimum of 5+ years of executive leadership experience (i.e.: CEO or divisional leadership), with demonstrated ability to manage the strategic, operational, and human capital needs of a national organization.
Exceptional communication skills, with an ability to connect with a wide range of audiences in a variety of settings (e.g. media engagements, Board meetings, donor pitches, government meetings, etc.).

Demonstrated success developing and translating vision into strategy, and a track record of designing and implementing plans for achieving ambitious growth.
Strong outcomes orientation with an ability to make data-driven decisions and maintain a constant eye on Hire Heroes USA's highest priorities in a dynamic environment.
Demonstrated success generating revenue, including a proven track record of raising capital across a wide variety of revenue streams; experience with corporate partnerships and/or major gifts is preferred.
Proven track record of finding, retaining, and cultivating strong collaborative partnerships over time.
Experience leading geographically dispersed teams in a hybrid work environment.
Ability to travel and have a presence at team, Board, and donor/partner meetings as needed.

The CEO will be expected to travel as needed for team meetings, donor cultivation, and other events, with some seasonal expectations exceeding 60%.
